text.en:
Beginning with the tobacco trading year 1976, no person, corporation, partnership or association
shall buy locally grown Virginia leaf tobacco at prices lower than the following:
GRADE AP7.00 per kilogram
GRADE B6.50 per kilogram
GRADE C6.00 per kilogram
GRADE D5.50 per kilogram
GRADE E5.00 per kilogram
The Description of each grade shall be determined by the Philippine Virginia Tobacco Administration.

The Philippine Virginia Tobacco Administration may hereafter fix the minimum prices at which
Virginia leaf tobacco may be purchased from tobacco farmers whenever the national interest so requires,
taking into consideration cost of production, transportation, marketing and other relevant factors.

The Philippine Virginia Tobacco Administration is hereby authorized to issue rules and
regulations necessary to implement the provisions of this Decree.

Any person who shall violate the provisions of this Decree and any rule or regulation that may
be issued by the Philippine Virginia Tobacco Administration pursuant to the authority granted in the
preceding section shall, upon conviction, be punished by a fine of not more than Twenty Thousand Pesos
(P20,000.00) and/or by imprisonment of not more than five years; PROVIDED, That in the case of
corporations, partnerships, associations or companies, the President, Manager or Administrator or the person
who has charge of the administration of the business shall be criminally responsible for any violation of this
Decree or of the rules and regulations that may be promulgated by the Philippine Virginia Tobacco
Administration pursuant to the authority in the next preceding section. If the offender is an alien, he shall be
deported immediately without further proceedings.
Any provision of law or decree in conflict herewith is revoked or amended immediately.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 26th day of February in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
